# JSON-Schema-Test-Suite 23.1.0

The official JSON Schema test suite, release 23.1.0
(https://github.com/json-schema-org/JSON-Schema-Test-Suite), copied
unchanged for drafts 4, 6, 7, 2019-09 and 2020-12 with its `remotes`.
MIT licence, in `LICENSE` beside this file.

It is the parity test of the JSON Schema converter (T674,
design/json-schema.md): each schema is converted to DXNS and each
instance checked against it. node-dextrin and php-dextrin read this same
copy.
